info.description:
Proxmox Virtual Environment REST API specification.

Generated from the official Proxmox apidoc.js with validation rules extracted from Perl source across 11 Proxmox repositories.

This spec includes x-since-version extensions on endpoints and parameters to indicate when each was introduced.

bridge.description:
Bridge to attach the network device to. The Proxmox VE standard bridge
is called 'vmbr0'.

If you do not specify a bridge, we create a kvm user (NATed) network
device, which provides DHCP and DNS services. The following addresses
are used:

 10.0.2.2   Gateway
 10.0.2.3   DNS Server
 10.0.2.4   SMB Server

The DHCP server assign addresses to the guest starting from 10.0.2.15.

 'bus-port(.port)*' (decimal numbers) or

bridge.description:
Bridge to attach the network device to. The Proxmox VE standard bridge
is called 'vmbr0'.

If you do not specify a bridge, we create a kvm user (NATed) network
device, which provides DHCP and DNS services. The following addresses
are used:

 10.0.2.4   SMB Server

The DHCP server assign addresses to the guest starting from 10.0.2.15.

bridge.description:
Bridge to attach the network device to. The Proxmox VE standard bridge
is called 'vmbr0'.

If you do not specify a bridge, we create a kvm user (NATed) network
device, which provides DHCP and DNS services. The following addresses
are used:

 10.0.2.2   Gateway
 10.0.2.3   DNS Server
 10.0.2.4   SMB Server

The DHCP server assign addresses to the guest starting from 10.0.2.15.

 'bus-port(.port)*' (decimal numbers) or
 'vendor_id:product_id' (hexadeciaml numbers) or
